title: Inverse Spectral Analysis of Singular Radial AKNS Operators
summary: We study an inverse spectral problem for singular AKNS operators based on spectral data associated with two distinct values of the effective angular momentum parameter $κ\,$. Our main focus is the local inverse problem near the zero potential. For the pairs $(κ_1,κ_2)=(0,1)$, $(1,2)$ and $(0,3)\,$, we establish local uniqueness. For $(0,2)\,$, we prove that the Fréchet differential of the spectral map at the origin is injective, while the question whether its range is closed remains open.
